{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for the presence of 'SEVERE' in the severity column
severe_present = df['severity'].isin(['severe', 'SEVERE', 'Severe']).any()

# Check the data type and range of biomarker_baseline
print("Severe severity present?", severe_present)
print("Data type of biomarker_baseline:", df['biomarker_baseline'].dtype)
print("Summary statistics for biomarker_baseline:", df['biomarker_baseline'].describe())"}
